clips.title: The story
paras: In western Silverpine, Skittering Dark lies abandoned beneath a web of danger. Giant spiders fill the mine and nearby woods, hunting unwary beasts and travelers.

The Skittering Dark lies east of North Tide's Run, where the western coast meets the hills. Once a working mine, its shafts now lie choked with cobwebs and serve as a sprawling nest for giant spiders. Krethis haunts the shadowed woods outside, while the spiders hunt anything that strays too close.
